[Post] 10. Move Filter Report and Documentation

Tested by :

QA (Quality Assurance) @ekosy9

Project :

Panorra PWA @rispan0

Description of Feature :

The Move Filter feature enables dynamic manipulation and rotation of the active spherical filter projection (such as Little Planet, Crystal Ball, or Dome) on 360° panoramic media. Viewers can drag across the canvas to reorient the focal distortion center and explore the surrounding scene seamlessly.

Device & Environment :

  • Environment: https://dev.panorra.com/
  • Dataset: Real High-Resolution 360° Panorama (1000401665.jpg from Test GoThru Photo Studio)
  • Device Spec: AMD Ryzen 3 4300U / Intel Core i5-4570 / Android 13 (8GB RAM)
  • Browser: Google Chrome (Desktop 1920x1032 & Mobile Responsive)

Main Functions :

Title Scenario
Description : Move Filter on 360° panoramic media posts
Actor : User & Guest Viewer
Interface : Post Timeline & Detail View (/p/[slug] & /fullscreen/[slug])
